import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { build } from 'esbuild'
const bundled = await build({ entryPoints: ['src/views/chart/components/views/components/g2-render-attempt.ts'], bundle: true, write: false, platform: 'node', format: 'esm', target: 'node18', logLevel: 'silent' })
const { createG2RenderAttempt, G2RenderAttemptFailure } = await import(`data:text/javascript;base64,${Buffer.from(bundled.outputFiles[0].text).toString('base64')}`)
const ready = async extra => createG2RenderAttempt({ create: () => ({ kind: 'instance', instance: { destroy() {} } }), isCurrent: () => true, setup() {}, render() {}, afterRender() {}, ...extra })
let cleanupCalls = 0
let destroys = 0
const a = await ready({ create: () => ({ kind: 'instance', instance: { destroy() { destroys++ } } }) })
const same = () => cleanupCalls++
assert.deepEqual(a.scope.replaceCleanup('key', same), [])
assert.deepEqual(a.scope.replaceCleanup('key', same), [])
assert.equal(cleanupCalls, 1)
assert.deepEqual(a.scope.dispose(), [])
assert.deepEqual(a.scope.dispose(), [])
assert.equal(cleanupCalls, 2)
assert.equal(destroys, 1)
console.log('PASS same_function_new_registration')
const cleanupError = new Error('cleanup')
const notifyError = new Error('notify')
const empty = await ready({ create: () => ({ kind: 'empty' }), initialCleanups: [{ key: 'initial', cleanup() { throw cleanupError } }], onCleanupErrors(errors) { assert.equal(errors[0], cleanupError); throw notifyError } })
assert.equal(empty.status, 'empty')
assert.equal(empty.cleanupErrors[0], cleanupError)
assert.equal(empty.cleanupErrors[1], notifyError)
assert.equal(empty.cleanupErrors.length, 2)
console.log('PASS empty_initial_cleanup_and_notify_errors')
const batches = []
const c = await ready({ onCleanupErrors: errors => batches.push(errors) })
c.scope.replaceCleanup('remove', () => { throw cleanupError })
const removed = c.scope.removeCleanup('remove')
assert.equal(removed[0], cleanupError)
assert.equal(removed.length, 1)
assert.equal(batches.length, 1)
assert.equal(batches[0][0], cleanupError)
assert.deepEqual(c.cleanupErrors, [])
assert.deepEqual(c.scope.dispose(), [])
console.log('PASS remove_error_independent_return_notification')
const primary = { reason: 'non-Error business failure' }
try { await ready({ create() { throw primary }, initialCleanups: [{ key: 'initial', cleanup() { throw cleanupError } }], onCleanupErrors() { throw notifyError } }); assert.fail('must reject') } catch (error) { assert.ok(error instanceof G2RenderAttemptFailure); assert.equal(error.code, 'G2_RENDER_ATTEMPT_FAILED'); assert.equal(error.originalError, primary); assert.equal(error.cause, primary); assert.equal(error.cleanupErrors[0], cleanupError); assert.equal(error.cleanupErrors[1], notifyError) }
console.log('PASS primary_reference_survives_cleanup_notification_failure')
let createCalls = 0
let initialCalls = 0
const stale = await ready({ isCurrent: () => false, create() { createCalls++; return { kind: 'empty' } }, initialCleanups: [{ key: 'initial', cleanup() { initialCalls++ } }] })
assert.equal(stale.status, 'stale')
assert.equal(createCalls, 0)
assert.equal(initialCalls, 1)
console.log('PASS stale_start_releases_initial_cleanup_without_create')
try { await ready({ create: () => ({ kind: 'instance', instance: null }) }); assert.fail('must reject') } catch (error) { assert.ok(error instanceof G2RenderAttemptFailure); assert.equal(error.code, 'G2_RENDER_INSTANCE_MISSING'); assert.equal(error.originalError, undefined) }
console.log('PASS malformed_instance_fails_closed')

source_patch:
--- g2-render-attempt.ts (independently validated RED stub)
+++ g2-render-attempt.ts (helper build candidate)
@@ -31,13 +31,152 @@
   | { status: 'ready'; scope: G2RenderScope<T>; cleanupErrors: Error[] }
   | { status: 'empty' | 'stale'; cleanupErrors: Error[] }
 
-// RED 准备入口：编译和导入必须成功，实际生命周期由后续独立 Builder 实现。
-export function createG2RenderAttempt<T extends G2RenderInstance>(
-  _options: G2RenderAttemptOptions<T>
+export class G2RenderAttemptFailure extends Error {
+  readonly code: 'G2_RENDER_ATTEMPT_FAILED' | 'G2_RENDER_INSTANCE_MISSING'
+  readonly originalError: unknown
+  readonly cause: unknown
+  readonly cleanupErrors: Error[]
+
+  constructor(
+    originalError: unknown,
+    cleanupErrors: Error[],
+    code: 'G2_RENDER_ATTEMPT_FAILED' | 'G2_RENDER_INSTANCE_MISSING' = 'G2_RENDER_ATTEMPT_FAILED'
+  ) {
+    super(
+      code === 'G2_RENDER_INSTANCE_MISSING'
+        ? 'G2 render attempt did not return an instance or an explicit empty result'
+        : 'G2 render attempt failed'
+    )
+    this.name = 'G2RenderAttemptFailure'
+    this.code = code
+    this.originalError = originalError
+    this.cause = originalError
+    this.cleanupErrors = [...cleanupErrors]
+  }
+}
+
+function cleanupError(error: unknown): Error {
+  if (error instanceof Error) return error
+  return Object.assign(new Error('G2 cleanup threw a non-Error value'), { cause: error })
+}
+
+export async function createG2RenderAttempt<T extends G2RenderInstance>(
+  options: G2RenderAttemptOptions<T>
 ): Promise<G2RenderAttemptResult<T>> {
-  return Promise.reject(
-    Object.assign(new Error('G2 render attempt is not implemented'), {
-      code: 'G2_RENDER_ATTEMPT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED'
-    })
-  )
+  const cleanups = new Map<string, G2RenderCleanup>()
+  const attemptErrors: Error[] = []
+  let instance: T | undefined
+  let closed = false
+  let finished = false
+  let missingInstance = false
+
+  const runCleanup = (cleanup: G2RenderCleanup): Error[] => {
+    try {
+      cleanup()
+      return []
+    } catch (error) {
+      return [cleanupError(error)]
+    }
+  }
+
+  // 通知只包含本次清理错误；通知自身的异常返回给调用者，不递归通知。
+  const reportCleanupErrors = (errors: Error[]): Error[] => {
+    if (!errors.length) return errors
+    const reported = [...errors]
+    try {
+      options.onCleanupErrors?.([...errors])
+    } catch (error) {
+      reported.push(cleanupError(error))
+    }
+    if (!finished) attemptErrors.push(...reported)
+    return reported
+  }
+
+  const dispose = (): Error[] => {
+    if (closed) return []
+    closed = true
+    const pending = [...cleanups.values()].reverse()
+    cleanups.clear()
+    const errors: Error[] = []
+    for (const cleanup of pending) errors.push(...runCleanup(cleanup))
+    const ownedInstance = instance
+    if (ownedInstance) errors.push(...runCleanup(() => ownedInstance.destroy()))
+    return errors
+  }
+
+  const removeCleanup = (key: string): Error[] => {
+    const cleanup = cleanups.get(key)
+    if (!cleanup) return []
+    // 先移除登记，cleanup 重入 remove/dispose 时不会重复执行本项。
+    cleanups.delete(key)
+    return reportCleanupErrors(runCleanup(cleanup))
+  }
+
+  const replaceCleanup = (key: string, cleanup: G2RenderCleanup): Error[] => {
+    const previous = cleanups.get(key)
+    cleanups.delete(key)
+    const errors = previous ? runCleanup(previous) : []
+    // previous 可能重入并关闭 scope，因此清理后再次判断 closed。
+    if (closed) errors.push(...runCleanup(cleanup))
+    else cleanups.set(key, cleanup)
+    return reportCleanupErrors(errors)
+  }
+
+  const release = () => reportCleanupErrors(dispose())
+  const terminal = (status: 'empty' | 'stale'): G2RenderAttemptResult<T> => {
+    release()
+    finished = true
+    return { status, cleanupErrors: [...attemptErrors] }
+  }
+  const current = () => !closed && options.isCurrent()
+
+  try {
+    for (const initial of options.initialCleanups ?? []) {
+      replaceCleanup(initial.key, initial.cleanup)
+    }
+    if (!current()) return terminal('stale')
+
+    const created = await options.create()
+    if (
+      !created ||
+      (created.kind !== 'empty' &&
+        (created.kind !== 'instance' ||
+          !created.instance ||
+          typeof created.instance.destroy !== 'function'))
+    ) {
+      missingInstance = true
+      throw new Error('G2 render instance is missing')
+    }
+    if (created.kind === 'instance') instance = created.instance
+    if (!current()) return terminal('stale')
+    if (created.kind === 'empty') return terminal('empty')
+
+    const scope: G2RenderScope<T> = {
+      instance: created.instance,
+      get closed() {
+        return closed
+      },
+      isCurrent: () => options.isCurrent(),
+      replaceCleanup,
+      removeCleanup,
+      dispose
+    }
+    options.setup(scope)
+    if (!current()) return terminal('stale')
+    await options.render(scope)
+    if (!current()) return terminal('stale')
+    await options.afterRender(scope)
+    if (!current()) return terminal('stale')
+
+    finished = true
+    return { status: 'ready', scope, cleanupErrors: [...attemptErrors] }
+  } catch (originalError) {
+    release()
+    finished = true
+    throw new G2RenderAttemptFailure(
+      missingInstance ? undefined : originalError,
+      attemptErrors,
+      missingInstance ? 'G2_RENDER_INSTANCE_MISSING' : 'G2_RENDER_ATTEMPT_FAILED'
+    )
+  }
 }
